subject.title: fix(agents): add size limit to LSP message parser

question: Should OpenClaw enforce a fixed universal 10 MB LSP response-frame limit for every bundled language server?
rationale: The LSP framing contract requires Content-Length but does not establish this project-specific maximum, so tests cannot decide the permanent compatibility boundary for existing servers.

options.title: Keep 10 MB after compatibility proof
options.body: Retain the fixed limit after representative real-server evidence and explicit owner acceptance of the failure behavior.

options.title: Choose a different fixed boundary
options.body: Use an owner-approved limit grounded in observed language-server response sizes and encode that rationale in tests.

options.title: Narrow to malformed lengths
options.body: Defer the universal finite-size cap and land only safe handling of invalid numeric Content-Length values.

recommendation.title: Keep 10 MB after compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Retain the fixed limit after representative real-server evidence and explicit owner acceptance of the failure behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor to the bundled LSP runtime and its session lifecycle.
